data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 were GBP 545.9m. During 2017 there was a net favourable prior-year development (release) of GBP 37.5m (approximately 6.9% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven by favourable technical provision movements across classes (notably third party liability). A small adverse movement occurred in Marine, while Fire (property), Third party liability and Miscellaneous experienced releases. 2017 catastrophe events (Harvey, Irma and Maria) are cited as materially affecting the year's underwriting result but are current-year catastrophe drivers rather than prior-year reserve deterioration.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in technical provisions forms an 11% (2016: 10%) component of the loss ratio for 2017: 58% (2016: 52%).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and prior year movement taken from Note 'Technical provisions' (opening gross claims outstanding GBP 545.9m) and Note 6 'Prior years' claims provision' (Favourable movement in technical provisions GBP 37.5m). Per-table parenthesis indicate adverse movement for Marine. Named catastrophe events (Harvey/Irma/Maria) are cited but no per-event quantified gross reserve impacts provided. Claims development triangle is present in the report but detailed development-period rows were not fully extracted here; therefore triangle-derived PYD was not used.
